adjudication_notes: Q01 does not expressly ask how Pods are randomly selected; the requested count, distribution, orientation and bag contents are correct.
Q02 first-miniature/First Encounter timing is accepted as equivalent wording; no contrary timing is asserted.
Q17 the question asks scan/removal contrast and Surgery consequences; unasked Canteen Light-Wound healing/Shower Slime removal are not required.
Q20 the named ordered checks and expressly asked outcomes are resolved; unrequested elaboration on non-Earth ship/Intruder status is not demanded.
Q21 shuffled face-down Engine pairs fully answer the requested initial Engine setup; later top-token interpretation is not separately requested.

Q50 gives multiple supported indirect-harm examples. The shortened grenade example is read as collateral harm in the stated indirect-action context, not an affirmative authorization to target only Characters.
Q56 its awkward no-cannot-survive wording is read with its explicit not-dead premise as denying objective fulfillment, not reversing it.

Q60 the stated two-card Nest Room Action versus one-card dropped-Object pickup and Noise distinction answer the requested comparison; generic Room restrictions need not be restated for every named Room Action.
